mix.reason: a scene mixer: it renders one or more inputs through a mixer scene given as a preset or a document, which the native CLI has no equivalent of. The name previously also spelled the native channel strip, so one command line meant two capabilities; that alias is gone and mix-strip is the only spelling for the strip

shared_schema_document.reason: The payload transports a document whose field names are fixed by a schema shared with the Node and WASM bindings. The names belong to that schema, not to the CLI, so the CLI must publish them unchanged; renaming them here would break the other surfaces to satisfy a rule about this one.
